properties.description: The /capture-session command reflow2 installs for every harness (copied to .claude/commands, and generated as a VS Code prompt file under .github/prompts). Its body is sent as the user's turn, so its wording is what a model provider's classifiers judge. Registered 2026-10-12 because its old wording ("what dies with the session is the reasoning") was the measured cause of Copilot's reasoning_extraction refusals and the design had no node for it; the other command files under getting-started/commands/ are still unregistered.
properties.name: getting-started/commands/capture-session.md — the /capture-session slash command
